output.summary: Tender perennial herb native to humid, wet parts of Brazil and Paraguay. Its elongated leaves contain intensely sweet compounds; Guaraní people used the plant for centuries to sweeten yerba mate and as a treat, while processed leaf extracts serve as sugar substitutes.
